# `csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types`

Put each member of an anonymous type on its own line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` | No effect yet unless `csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers = false` is set too ([#259](https://github.com/nullean/curb/issues/259)). `dotnet format` reads this key alone. |

**Default:** `true`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types = true`

```ini
csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public object Describe()
    {
        return new
        {
            Name = "curb", Version = 1,
            Active = true,
        };
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public object Describe()
    {
        return new
        {
            Name = "curb",
            Version = 1,
            Active = true,
        };
    }
}
```
:::

::::
